---
title: "RNA-Integrate Report"
author: ""
date: ""
output: html_document
params:
  
  # --- Run identity ---
  mrna_experiment_id: "mrna_experiment_id_no_spaces"
  small_rna_experiment_id: "smallrna_experiment_id_no_spaces"
  integrative_experiment_id: "integrative_experiment_id_no_spaces"
  
  # --- Software methods ---
  mrna_software_method: "counts_matrix | rsem | htseq | salmon | kallisto"
  small_rna_software_method: "counts_matrix | tiny_rna"
  
  # --- Input data ---
  mrna_counts_matrix: "path/to/mrna_counts_matrix.csv (leave blank for rsem)"
  small_rna_counts_matrix: "path/to/smallrna_counts_matrix.csv"
  mrna_metadata: "path/to/mrna_metadata.csv"
  small_rna_metadata: "path/to/smallrna_metadata.csv"
  
  # --- Gene table ---
  mrna_gene_table_method: "full_table | common_names_only | gene_class_only | no_table"
  small_rna_gene_table_method: "full_table | common_names_only | gene_class_only | no_table"
  gene_table: "path/to/gene_table.csv"
  
  # --- Core outputs (tables/plots toggles) ---
  generate_results_tables: TRUE
  generate_integrative_results_tables: TRUE
  generate_pca: TRUE
  generate_intra_condition: TRUE
  generate_mean_reads: TRUE
  generate_ma: TRUE
  generate_heatmap: TRUE
  generate_statistical_analysis: TRUE
  
  # --- Mean reads: interactive behavior ---
  save_mean_reads_interactive: FALSE
  
  # --- Significance & styling thresholds ---
  p_value_threshold: 0.05
  fold_change_threshold: 1.3
  lower_transparency: 0.2
  upper_transparency: 0.9
  
  # --- Class-based styling ---
  customize_by_class: TRUE
  customize_by_significance: FALSE
  mrna_class_parameters: "path/to/mrna_class_parameters.csv"
  small_rna_class_parameters: "path/to/smallrna_class_parameters.csv"
  
  # --- Heatmap configuration ---
  heatmap_type: "complete | all_classes | selected_classes"
  heatmap_selected_classes: "class1 | class2"
  
  # --- Integrative analyses ---
  cross_comparisons: "mrna_vs_smallrna | custom"
  generate_cosmic_plots: TRUE
  generate_slope_plots: TRUE
  slope_plot_classes: "ALG,CSR,miRNA,WAGO"

```{r setup,echo=FALSE,include=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
# ---- Required packages ----
require_package <- function(pkg) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop(
      "Missing required R package: '", pkg, "'. Please install it before knitting.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
}

required_packages <- c(
  "knitr",
  "rmarkdown",
  "yaml",
  "plotly",
  "htmlwidgets",
  "htmltools",
  "DT",
  "webshot2",
  "ggplot2",
  "pagedown",
  "pdftools"
)

invisible(lapply(required_packages, require_package))

library(knitr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)


# ---- Validation helpers ----
require_file <- function(path, label) {
  if (is.null(path) || identical(path, "")) {
    stop("Missing required parameter: ", label, ".", call. = FALSE)
  }

  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    stop("File not found for ", label, ": ", path, call. = FALSE)
  }

  invisible(TRUE)
}

require_columns <- function(df, required_columns, label) {
  missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, colnames(df))

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      label, " is missing required column(s): ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "),
      "\nColumns present: ", paste(colnames(df), collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  invisible(TRUE)
}

render_subpipeline <- function(rmd_path, output_file, pipeline_params, label) {
  if (!file.exists(rmd_path)) {
    stop("Cannot find ", label, " Rmd at: ", rmd_path, call. = FALSE)
  }

  caller_env <- parent.frame()

  tryCatch(
    rmarkdown::render(
      input = rmd_path,
      output_file = output_file,
      params = pipeline_params,
      envir = caller_env
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      stop(
        "Failed while rendering the ", label, " pipeline.\n",
        "Rmd: ", rmd_path, "\n",
        "Error: ", e$message,
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }
  )
}


# ---- Shared parameter builder for DESeq2 sub-pipelines ----
build_deseq2_params <- function(
  experiment_id,
  software_method,
  counts_matrix,
  metadata,
  gene_table_method,
  class_parameters,
  global_params
) {
  list(
    experiment_id = experiment_id,
    software_method = software_method,
    counts_matrix = counts_matrix,
    metadata = metadata,
    gene_table_method = gene_table_method,
    gene_table = global_params$gene_table,
    generate_results_tables = global_params$generate_results_tables,
    generate_pca = global_params$generate_pca,
    generate_intra_condition = global_params$generate_intra_condition,
    generate_mean_reads = global_params$generate_mean_reads,
    save_mean_reads_interactive = global_params$save_mean_reads_interactive,
    p_value_threshold = global_params$p_value_threshold,
    fold_change_threshold = global_params$fold_change_threshold,
    lower_transparency = global_params$lower_transparency,
    upper_transparency = global_params$upper_transparency,
    customize_by_class = global_params$customize_by_class,
    customize_by_significance = global_params$customize_by_significance,
    class_parameters = class_parameters,
    generate_ma = global_params$generate_ma,
    generate_heatmap = global_params$generate_heatmap,
    heatmap_type = global_params$heatmap_type,
    heatmap_selected_classes = global_params$heatmap_selected_classes
  )
}


# ---- Parameter lists ----
small_rna_params <- build_deseq2_params(

)

  metadata = params$mrna_metadata,

)

integrative_params <- list(
  integrative_experiment_id = params$integrative_experiment_id,
  gene_table = params$gene_table,
  cross_comparisons = params$cross_comparisons,
  generate_integrative_results_tables = params$generate_integrative_results_tables,
  generate_cosmic_plots = params$generate_cosmic_plots,
  generate_slope_plots = params$generate_slope_plots,
  generate_statistical_analysis = params$generate_statistical_analysis,
  slope_plot_classes = params$slope_plot_classes,
  p_value_threshold = params$p_value_threshold,
  fold_change_threshold = params$fold_change_threshold
)


# ---- Input validation ----
require_file(small_rna_params$counts_matrix, "small_rna_counts_matrix")
require_file(small_rna_params$metadata, "small_rna_metadata")

if (isTRUE(params$customize_by_class) && !identical(small_rna_params$class_parameters, "")) {
  require_file(small_rna_params$class_parameters, "small_rna_class_parameters")
}

require_file(mrna_params$metadata, "mrna_metadata")

if (isTRUE(params$customize_by_class) && !identical(mrna_params$class_parameters, "")) {
  require_file(mrna_params$class_parameters, "mrna_class_parameters")
}

if (identical(mrna_params$software_method, "counts_matrix")) {
  require_file(mrna_params$counts_matrix, "mrna_counts_matrix")
}

require_file(integrative_params$gene_table, "gene_table")


# ---- Cleanup ----
rm(params)
```

```{r integrative-setup,include=FALSE}

# ---- Run timestamp for output naming ----
run_stamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S_")

# ---- Create output directory ----
out_dir <- file.path(
  getwd(),
  paste0(run_stamp, integrative_params$integrative_experiment_id, "_output")
)

dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)


# ---- Save integrative parameter record ----
yaml::write_yaml(
  integrative_params,
  file.path(
    out_dir,
    paste0(
      integrative_params$integrative_experiment_id, "_",
      run_stamp,
      "params.yml"
    )
  )
)


# ---- Import gene table ----
gene_table <- read.csv(
  integrative_params$gene_table,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


# ---- Validate gene table ----
if (nrow(gene_table) == 0) {
  stop("gene_table contains 0 rows.", call. = FALSE)
}

require_columns(
  gene_table,
  c("sRNA_ID", "sRNA_Name", "sRNA_Class", "Target_ID"),
  "gene_table"
)

# ---- Add optional Target_Name column if missing ----
if (!"Target_Name" %in% colnames(gene_table)) {
  gene_table$Target_Name <- gene_table$Target_ID
}

# ---- Fill blank Target_Name values ----
gene_table$Target_Name[
  is.na(gene_table$Target_Name) |
    gene_table$Target_Name == ""
] <- gene_table$Target_ID[
  is.na(gene_table$Target_Name) |
    gene_table$Target_Name == ""
]


# ---- Keep only valid small RNA–mRNA target pairs ----
target_pairs <- gene_table[
  gene_table$sRNA_ID %in% names(small_rna_cts_names) &
    gene_table$Target_ID %in% names(mrna_cts_names),
  c("sRNA_ID", "sRNA_Name", "sRNA_Class", "Target_ID", "Target_Name")
]


# ---- Validate filtered target pairs ----
if (nrow(target_pairs) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No valid small RNA–mRNA target pairs were found.\n",
    "Common causes:\n",
    "gene_table sRNA_ID values do not match names(small_rna_cts_names)\n",
    "gene_table Target_ID values do not match names(mrna_cts_names)",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}


cosmic_plot <- function(target_data, comparison_name) {

  # ---- Significance thresholds ----
  p_threshold <- integrative_params$p_value_threshold
  fc_threshold <- integrative_params$fold_change_threshold
  log2_fc_threshold <- log2(fc_threshold)

  # ---- Labels for legend text and hover text ----
  sig_srna_label <- paste0(
    "sRNA: padj < ", p_threshold,
    " & |log2FC| > ", round(log2_fc_threshold, 3)
  )

  sig_mrna_label <- paste0(
    "mRNA: padj < ", p_threshold,
    " & |log2FC| > ", round(log2_fc_threshold, 3)
  )

  nonsig_srna_label <- "sRNA: not significant"
  nonsig_mrna_label <- "mRNA: not significant"

  hover_sig_sig <- paste0(
    "<b>",
    sig_srna_label,
    "<br>",
    sig_mrna_label,
    "</b><br>"
  )

  hover_sig_nonsig <- paste0(
    "<b>",
    sig_srna_label,
    "<br>",
    nonsig_mrna_label,
    "</b><br>"
  )

  hover_nonsig_sig <- paste0(
    "<b>",
    nonsig_srna_label,
    "<br>",
    sig_mrna_label,
    "</b><br>"
  )

  hover_nonsig_nonsig <- paste0(
    "<b>",
    nonsig_srna_label,
    "<br>",
    nonsig_mrna_label,
    "</b><br>"
  )

  # ---- Significance flags ----
  srna_significant <- (target_data$small_rna_p_value < p_threshold) &
    (abs(target_data$small_rna_fold_change) > log2_fc_threshold)

  mrna_significant <- (target_data$mrna_p_value < p_threshold) &
    (abs(target_data$mrna_fold_change) > log2_fc_threshold)

  # ---- Shared small RNA color scale ----
  target_data$srna_color_val <- log2(target_data$small_rna_mean)

  color_min <- min(target_data$srna_color_val, na.rm = TRUE)
  color_max <- max(target_data$srna_color_val, na.rm = TRUE)

  # ---- Subset data into four significance groups ----
  data_sig_sig <- target_data[srna_significant & mrna_significant, ]
  data_sig_nonsig <- target_data[srna_significant & !mrna_significant, ]
  data_nonsig_sig <- target_data[!srna_significant & mrna_significant, ]
  data_nonsig_nonsig <- target_data[!srna_significant & !mrna_significant, ]

  # ---- Values used for point-size legend ----
  size_vals <- c(
    data_sig_sig$mrna_log2_mean,
    data_nonsig_sig$mrna_log2_mean
  )

  size_vals <- size_vals[is.finite(size_vals)]

  if (length(size_vals) == 0) {
    legend_vals <- c(0, 0, 0, 0)
  } else {
    legend_vals <- seq(
      min(size_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
      max(size_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
      length.out = 4
    )
  }

  # ---- Point-size legend geometry ----
  x_positions <- c(1.05, 1.13, 1.21, 1.29)
  x_radii <- c(0.0015, 0.0024, 0.0033, 0.0042)
  y_radii <- c(0.0020, 0.0033, 0.0046, 0.0059)

  # ---- Quadrant dot counts ----
  count_quad <- function(df, x_pos, y_pos) {
    x_ok <- if (x_pos) {
      df$small_rna_fold_change > 0
    } else {
      df$small_rna_fold_change <= 0
    }

    y_ok <- if (y_pos) {
      df$mrna_fold_change > 0
    } else {
      df$mrna_fold_change <= 0
    }

    sum(x_ok & y_ok, na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  quad_label <- function(x_pos, y_pos) {
    paste0(
      "<span style='color:#E65396'>&#9679;</span> ",
      count_quad(data_sig_sig, x_pos, y_pos),
      "<br>",
      "<span style='color:#2171B5'>&#9679;</span> ",
      count_quad(data_sig_nonsig, x_pos, y_pos),
      "<br>",
      "<span style='color:#E69F00'>&#9679;</span> ",
      count_quad(data_nonsig_sig, x_pos, y_pos),
      "<br>",
      "<span style='color:#808080'>&#9679;</span> ",
      count_quad(data_nonsig_nonsig, x_pos, y_pos)
    )
  }

  plot_object <- plot_ly(width = 1400, height = 850) %>%

    add_trace(
      data = data_sig_sig,
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "markers",
      x = ~small_rna_fold_change,
      y = ~mrna_fold_change,
      size = ~mrna_log2_mean,
      sizes = c(4, 50),
      marker = list(
        color = ~srna_color_val,
        cmin = color_min,
        cmax = color_max,
        colorscale = list(
          list(0.0, "#F6D6E6"),
          list(0.11, "#F2B6D2"),
          list(0.22, "#EE95BE"),
          list(0.33, "#EA74AA"),
          list(0.44, "#E65396"),
          list(0.56, "#D74286"),
          list(0.67, "#C83276"),
          list(0.78, "#B82266"),
          list(0.89, "#A81256"),
          list(1.0, "#8F0046")
        ),
        showscale = TRUE,
        colorbar = list(
          title = list(text = "sRNA log2 mean", side = "top"),
          orientation = "h",
          x = 1.02,
          xanchor = "left",
          y = 0.80,
          yanchor = "top",
          len = 0.28,
          thickness = 15
        ),
        line = list(width = 0)
      ),
      opacity = 1.0,
      text = ~paste0(
        hover_sig_sig,
        "<br>sRNA: ", small_rna,
        "<br>sRNA class: ", small_rna_class,
        "<br><br>mRNA: ", mrna,
        "<br>mRNA target ID: ", mrna_target
      ),
      hoverinfo = "text",
      customdata = paste(data_sig_sig$small_rna, data_sig_sig$mrna, sep = "|||"),
      name = "sig sRNA, sig mRNA",
      showlegend = TRUE
    ) %>%

    add_trace(
      data = data_sig_nonsig,
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "markers",
      x = ~small_rna_fold_change,
      y = ~mrna_fold_change,
      size = I(4),
      marker = list(
        color = ~srna_color_val,
        cmin = color_min,
        cmax = color_max,
        colorscale = list(
          list(0.0, "#C6DBEF"),
          list(0.11, "#9ECAE1"),
          list(0.22, "#6BAED6"),
          list(0.33, "#4292C6"),
          list(0.44, "#2171B5"),
          list(0.56, "#08519C"),
          list(0.67, "#08306B"),
          list(0.78, "#041b3c"),
          list(0.89, "#000000"),
          list(1.0, "#000000")
        ),
        showscale = TRUE,
        colorbar = list(
          title = list(text = "sRNA log2 mean", side = "top"),
          orientation = "h",
          x = 1.02,
          xanchor = "left",
          y = 0.58,
          yanchor = "top",
          len = 0.28,
          thickness = 15
        ),
        line = list(width = 0)
      ),
      opacity = 0.6,
      text = ~paste0(
        hover_sig_nonsig,
        "<br>sRNA: ", small_rna,
        "<br>sRNA class: ", small_rna_class,
        "<br><br>mRNA: ", mrna,
        "<br>mRNA target ID: ", mrna_target
      ),
      hoverinfo = "text",
      customdata = paste(data_sig_nonsig$small_rna, data_sig_nonsig$mrna, sep = "|||"),
      name = "sig sRNA, nonsig mRNA",
      showlegend = TRUE
    ) %>%

    add_trace(
      data = data_nonsig_sig,
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "markers",
      x = ~small_rna_fold_change,
      y = ~mrna_fold_change,
      size = ~mrna_log2_mean,
      sizes = c(4, 50),
      marker = list(
        color = "#E69F00",
        line = list(width = 0)
      ),
      opacity = 0.4,
      text = ~paste0(
        hover_nonsig_sig,
        "<br>sRNA: ", small_rna,
        "<br>sRNA class: ", small_rna_class,
        "<br><br>mRNA: ", mrna,
        "<br>mRNA target ID: ", mrna_target
      ),
      hoverinfo = "text",
      customdata = paste(data_nonsig_sig$small_rna, data_nonsig_sig$mrna, sep = "|||"),
      name = "nonsig sRNA, sig mRNA",
      showlegend = TRUE
    ) %>%

    add_trace(
      data = data_nonsig_nonsig,
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "markers",
      x = ~small_rna_fold_change,
      y = ~mrna_fold_change,
      size = I(4),
      marker = list(
        color = "#808080",
        line = list(width = 0)
      ),
      opacity = 0.3,
      text = ~paste0(
        hover_nonsig_nonsig,
        "<br>sRNA: ", small_rna,
        "<br>sRNA class: ", small_rna_class,
        "<br><br>mRNA: ", mrna,
        "<br>mRNA target ID: ", mrna_target
      ),
      hoverinfo = "text",
      customdata = paste(data_nonsig_nonsig$small_rna, data_nonsig_nonsig$mrna, sep = "|||"),
      name = "nonsig sRNA, nonsig mRNA",
      showlegend = TRUE
    ) %>%

    layout(
      title = list(
        text = paste0("<b>", comparison_name, "</b>"),
        font = list(size = 24),

slope_plot <- function(target_data, comparison_name, slope_plot_classes) {

  # ---- Significance threshold (padj only for slope plot) ----
  p_thresh <- integrative_params$p_value_threshold

  # ---- 4-group significance colors (matching scatter plot) ----
  sig_groups <- list(
    list(
      label = "sig sRNA, sig mRNA",
      color = "#E65396",
      srna_sig = TRUE,
      mrna_sig = TRUE
    ),
    list(
      label = "sig sRNA, nonsig mRNA",
      color = "#2171B5",
      srna_sig = TRUE,
      mrna_sig = FALSE
    ),
    list(
      label = "nonsig sRNA, sig mRNA",
      color = "#E69F00",
      srna_sig = FALSE,
      mrna_sig = TRUE
    ),
    list(
      label = "nonsig sRNA, nonsig mRNA",
      color = "#808080",
      srna_sig = FALSE,
      mrna_sig = FALSE
    )
  )

  # ---- Build per-pair data (one row per sRNA-mRNA pair) ----
  pair_data <- data.frame(
    index = seq_len(nrow(target_data)),
    class = target_data$small_rna_class,
    srna_id = target_data$small_rna,
    mrna_id = target_data$mrna,
    srna_fc = as.numeric(target_data$small_rna_fold_change),
    mrna_fc = as.numeric(target_data$mrna_fold_change),
    srna_mean = as.numeric(target_data$small_rna_mean),
    mrna_mean = as.numeric(target_data$mrna_mean),
    srna_padj = as.numeric(target_data$small_rna_p_value),
    mrna_padj = as.numeric(target_data$mrna_p_value),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # ---- Assign significance group (padj only) ----
  srna_sig <- !is.na(pair_data$srna_padj) &
    pair_data$srna_padj < p_thresh

  mrna_sig <- !is.na(pair_data$mrna_padj) &
    pair_data$mrna_padj < p_thresh

  pair_data$sig_group <- ifelse(
    srna_sig & mrna_sig,
    "sig sRNA, sig mRNA",
    ifelse(
      srna_sig & !mrna_sig,
      "sig sRNA, nonsig mRNA",
      ifelse(
        !srna_sig & mrna_sig,
        "nonsig sRNA, sig mRNA",
        "nonsig sRNA, nonsig mRNA"
      )
    )
  )

  # ---- Keep only requested classes ----
  pair_data <- pair_data[pair_data$class %in% slope_plot_classes, ]
  slope_plot_classes <- slope_plot_classes[slope_plot_classes %in% pair_data$class]

  # ---- Guard: return message if no data ----
  if (nrow(pair_data) == 0) {
    return(htmltools::tagList(
      plotly::plot_ly() %>%
        plotly::layout(
          annotations = list(
            list(
              text = paste0("No data for classes: ", paste(slope_plot_classes, collapse = ", ")),
              x = 0.5,
              y = 0.5,
              xref = "paper",
              yref = "paper",
              showarrow = FALSE,
              font = list(size = 14, color = "#444444")
            )
          )
        )
    ))
  }

  # ---- Alpha inversely proportional to class size ----
  calc_alpha <- function(n) pmax(0.06, 1 / (1 + (n / 100)))

  # ---- Helper: rgba string from hex + alpha ----
  to_rgba <- function(hex, alpha) {
    rgb_vals <- as.integer(col2rgb(hex))
    paste0("rgba(", paste(rgb_vals, collapse = ","), ",", round(alpha, 3), ")")
  }

  # ---- Build one figure per class ----
  fig_list <- lapply(sort(slope_plot_classes), function(cls) {

    cls_data <- pair_data[pair_data$class == cls, ]
    cls_alpha <- calc_alpha(nrow(cls_data))

    sig_title <- paste0(
      "<b>", cls, "</b><br>",
      "<sup>", comparison_name,
      " | significance: padj &lt; ", p_thresh,
      "</sup>"
    )

    fig <- plotly::plot_ly()

    for (grp in sig_groups) {
      grp_data <- cls_data[cls_data$sig_group == grp$label, ]
      line_col <- to_rgba(grp$color, cls_alpha)

      # ---- Build x, y, text vectors with NA separators between pairs ----
      # Each pair contributes: "sRNA", "mRNA", NA (3 elements)
      # This puts all lines in ONE trace -> legend always shows a colored line icon
      if (nrow(grp_data) > 0) {
        hover_per_pair <- paste0(
          "sRNA: ", grp_data$srna_id,
          "<br>mRNA: ", grp_data$mrna_id,
          "<br>class: ", grp_data$class,
          "<br>sRNA log2FC: ", round(grp_data$srna_fc, 3),
          "<br>mRNA log2FC: ", round(grp_data$mrna_fc, 3),
          "<br>sRNA mean: ", round(grp_data$srna_mean, 2),
          "<br>mRNA mean: ", round(grp_data$mrna_mean, 2),
          "<br>sRNA padj: ", signif(grp_data$srna_padj, 3),
          "<br>mRNA padj: ", signif(grp_data$mrna_padj, 3)
        )

        x_vec <- rep(c("sRNA", "mRNA", NA_character_), nrow(grp_data))
        y_vec <- as.vector(rbind(grp_data$srna_fc, grp_data$mrna_fc, rep(NA_real_, nrow(grp_data))))
        t_vec <- as.vector(rbind(hover_per_pair, hover_per_pair, rep("", nrow(grp_data))))

        cd_ids <- paste(grp_data$srna_id, grp_data$mrna_id, sep = "|||")
        cd_vec <- as.vector(rbind(cd_ids, cd_ids, rep("", nrow(grp_data))))
      } else {
        # Empty group: invisible trace so legend entry still appears
        x_vec <- c(NA_character_, NA_character_)
        y_vec <- c(NA_real_, NA_real_)
        t_vec <- c("", "")
        cd_vec <- c("", "")
      }

      fig <- fig %>% plotly::add_trace(
        type = "scatter",
        mode = "lines",
        x = x_vec,
        y = y_vec,
        text = t_vec,
        customdata = cd_vec,
        line = list(color = line_col, width = 1),
        name = paste0("<span style='color:", grp$color, "'>", grp$label, "</span>"),
        showlegend = TRUE,
        hoverinfo = "text"
      )
    }

    fig <- fig %>% plotly::layout(
      title = list(text = sig_title, font = list(size = 13)),
      xaxis = list(
        title = "Feature Type",
        categoryorder = "array",
        categoryarray = c("sRNA", "mRNA"),
        tickfont = list(size = 12)
      ),
      yaxis = list(
        title = "log2 fold change",
        tickfont = list(size = 12)
      ),
      legend = list(
        title = list(text = "<b>Select Data to Display</b>"),
        x = 1.01,
        xanchor = "left"
      ),
      hovermode = "closest"
    )

    fig
  })

  # ---- Return all class figures together ----
  htmltools::tagList(fig_list)
}


integrative_statistics <- function(target_data, comparison_name) {

  # ---- Keep valid numeric fold changes ----
  base_data <- target_data[
    is.finite(target_data$small_rna_fold_change) &
      is.finite(target_data$mrna_fold_change),
  ]

  # ---- Keep only directional pairs ----
  base_data <- base_data[
    base_data$small_rna_fold_change != 0 &
      base_data$mrna_fold_change != 0,
  ]

  # ---- Prepare data for sign test ----
  sign_data <- base_data[
    base_data$small_rna_p_value < integrative_params$p_value_threshold &
      abs(base_data$small_rna_fold_change) > log2(integrative_params$fold_change_threshold) &
      base_data$mrna_p_value < integrative_params$p_value_threshold &
      abs(base_data$mrna_fold_change) > log2(integrative_params$fold_change_threshold),
  ]

  # ---- Sign test counts ----
  total_pairs <- nrow(sign_data)

  if (total_pairs == 0) {
    sign_table <- data.frame(
      Metric = c(
        "Total pairs",
        "Inverse pairs",
        "Direct pairs",
        "Proportion inverse",
        "Binomial test p-value"
      ),
      Value = c(0, NA, NA, NA, NA),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    inverse_flag <- sign(sign_data$small_rna_fold_change) !=
      sign(sign_data$mrna_fold_change)

    inverse_pairs <- sum(inverse_flag, na.rm = TRUE)
    direct_pairs <- total_pairs - inverse_pairs
    proportion_inverse <- inverse_pairs / total_pairs

    sign_test <- binom.test(
      x = inverse_pairs,
      n = total_pairs,
      p = 0.5,
      alternative = "greater"
    )

    sign_table <- data.frame(
      Metric = c(
        "Total pairs",
        "Inverse pairs",
        "Direct pairs",
        "Proportion inverse",
        "Binomial test p-value"
      ),
      Value = c(
        total_pairs,
        inverse_pairs,
        direct_pairs,
        round(proportion_inverse, 3),
        format(sign_test$p.value, digits = 3, scientific = TRUE)
      ),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }

  return(list(
    sign_table = sign_table
  ))
}
```

```{r integrative-render,include=FALSE}

# ---- Initialize knitted output containers ----
integrative_results_tables_out <- NULL
cosmic_plots_out <- NULL
slope_plots_out <- NULL
statistical_analysis_out <- NULL


# ---- Messages for outputs not selected for rendering ----
if (!integrative_params$generate_integrative_results_tables) {
  integrative_results_tables_out <- "Integrative Results Tables not marked for rendering"
}

  cosmic_plots_out <- "Cosmic Plots not marked for rendering"
}

if (!integrative_params$generate_slope_plots) {
  slope_plots_out <- "Slope Plots not marked for rendering"
}

if (!integrative_params$generate_statistical_analysis) {
  statistical_analysis_out <- "Statistical Analysis not marked for rendering"
}


# ---- Determine comparison list ----
if (identical(integrative_params$cross_comparisons, "")) {
  cross_comparisons <- intersect(
    colnames(small_rna_combinations),
    colnames(mrna_combinations)
  )
} else {
  cross_comparisons <- trimws(
    unlist(strsplit(integrative_params$cross_comparisons, ","))
  )
}


# ---- Determine slope plot classes ----
if (identical(integrative_params$slope_plot_classes, "")) {
  slope_plot_classes <- unique(gene_table$sRNA_Class)
} else {
  slope_plot_classes <- trimws(
    unlist(strsplit(integrative_params$slope_plot_classes, ","))
  )
}


# ---- Loop over comparisons ----
for (i in seq_along(cross_comparisons)) {

  comparison_id <- cross_comparisons[i]
  comparison_label <- sub("_vs_", " vs ", comparison_id)

  # ---- Match comparison IDs in results objects ----
  small_rna_res_id <- which(colnames(small_rna_combinations) == comparison_id)
  mrna_res_id <- which(colnames(mrna_combinations) == comparison_id)

  # ---- Skip comparisons not found in both result sets ----
  if (length(small_rna_res_id) == 0 || length(mrna_res_id) == 0) {
    next
  }

  # ---- Construct integrative target data ----
  small_rna_stats <- as.data.frame(
  small_rna_res[[small_rna_res_id]][target_pairs$sRNA_ID, c(1, 2, 6)]
)

mrna_stats <- as.data.frame(
  mrna_res[[mrna_res_id]][target_pairs$Target_ID, c(1, 2, 6)]
)

target_data <- data.frame(
  small_rna = unname(small_rna_cts_names[target_pairs$sRNA_ID]),
  small_rna_class = unname(small_rna_class_names[target_pairs$sRNA_ID]),
  small_rna_mean = small_rna_stats[, 1],
  small_rna_fold_change = small_rna_stats[, 2],
  small_rna_p_value = small_rna_stats[, 3],
  mrna_target = target_pairs$Target_ID,
  mrna = target_pairs$Target_Name,
  mrna_class = rep("mRNA", nrow(target_pairs)),
  mrna_mean = mrna_stats[, 1],
  mrna_fold_change = mrna_stats[, 2],
  mrna_p_value = mrna_stats[, 3],
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

target_data <- target_data[
  !is.na(target_data$small_rna_mean) &
    !is.na(target_data$small_rna_fold_change) &
    !is.na(target_data$small_rna_p_value) &
    !is.na(target_data$mrna_mean) &
    !is.na(target_data$mrna_fold_change) &
    !is.na(target_data$mrna_p_value),
]

if (nrow(target_data) == 0) {
  stop("target_data is empty for comparison: ", comparison_id, call. = FALSE)
}

  # ---- Convert numeric columns ----
  target_data$small_rna_mean <- as.numeric(target_data$small_rna_mean)
  target_data$small_rna_fold_change <- as.numeric(target_data$small_rna_fold_change)
  target_data$small_rna_p_value <- as.numeric(target_data$small_rna_p_value)

  target_data$mrna_mean <- as.numeric(target_data$mrna_mean)
  target_data$mrna_log2_mean <- log2(target_data$mrna_mean + 1)
  target_data$mrna_fold_change <- as.numeric(target_data$mrna_fold_change)
  target_data$mrna_p_value <- as.numeric(target_data$mrna_p_value)

  # ---- Store full target data for plotting ----
  assign(paste0("target_data", i, "_plots"), target_data)


  # ---- Statistical analysis: render and store ----
  if (integrative_params$generate_statistical_analysis) {

    stats_out <- integrative_statistics(
      target_data,
      comparison_label
    )

    assign(paste0("sign_test_table", i), stats_out$sign_table)

    # ---- Save statistical analysis tables ----
    write.csv(
      stats_out$sign_table,
      file.path(
        out_dir,
        paste0(
          integrative_params$integrative_experiment_id, "_",
          comparison_id,
          "_sign_test.csv"
        )
      ),
      row.names = FALSE
    )

    statistical_analysis_out <- c(
      statistical_analysis_out,
      knit_expand(text = paste0("### ", comparison_label))
    )

    statistical_analysis_out <- c(
      statistical_analysis_out,
      paste0(
        "#### Sign Test\n",
        "Inverse relationships were defined as small RNA–mRNA target pairs exhibiting opposite log₂ fold-change directions, whereas direct relationships were defined as target pairs exhibiting matching fold-change directions. For statistical testing, both the small RNA and corresponding mRNA were required to pass the selected adjusted p-value and fold-change thresholds. A one-sided binomial sign test was performed to evaluate whether inverse-direction target pairs occurred more frequently than expected under the null hypothesis of equal proportions of inverse and direct relationships (p = 0.5). Enrichment of inverse-direction relationships may be consistent with small RNA-mediated regulation; however, these results should be interpreted as evidence of association rather than direct mechanistic validation."
      )
    )

    statistical_analysis_out <- c(
      statistical_analysis_out,
      knit_expand(
        text = "```{r sign-test-table{{i}},echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE}\nDT::datatable(sign_test_table{{i}}, options = list(dom = 't', paging = FALSE), rownames = FALSE)\n```\n"
      )
    )

  } else {
    statistical_analysis_out <- c(statistical_analysis_out, "")
  }


  # ---- Integrative results tables: render and save ----
  if (integrative_params$generate_integrative_results_tables) {

    target_data_results <- target_data

    # ---- Round means to 1 decimal ----
    target_data_results[c("small_rna_mean", "mrna_mean")] <- lapply(

    colnames(target_data_results) <- c(

    assign(paste0("target_data", i), target_data_results)

    write.csv(

    integrative_results_tables_out <- c(

      )

  } else {
    integrative_results_tables_out <- c(integrative_results_tables_out, "")

  # ---- Cosmic plots: render and save ----
  if (integrative_params$generate_cosmic_plots) {
    cosmic_plot_object <- cosmic_plot(target_data, comparison_label)
```

The RNA Integrative Pipeline is designed to combine differential expression results from matched small RNA and mRNA sequencing experiments to enable integrated analysis of regulatory relationships. Separate DESeq2 analyses are first performed for small RNA and mRNA datasets, after which results are merged using an imported gene table defining small RNA–mRNA target relationships.

For each experimental comparison shared across datasets, the pipeline generates integrative results tables and interactive visualizations that summarize fold-change relationships between small RNAs and their corresponding mRNA targets. These outputs facilitate exploration of expression patterns while preserving statistical information derived from the underlying DESeq2 analyses.

Only target pairs with valid differential expression statistics in both datasets are retained for downstream analysis. Statistical thresholds, including adjusted p-value and fold-change cutoffs, are controlled through the associated YAML parameter file and applied consistently across integrative analyses.

For details about the individual DESeq2 pipeline, visit: <https://github.com/MontgomeryLab/DESeq2App/tree/main/Markdown_Pipeline>

For details about the integrative pipeline, visit: <https://github.com/MontgomeryLab/DESeq2App/tree/main/Integrative_Pipeline>

## Integrative Results Tables {.tabset}

Integrative Results Tables summarize differential expression metrics for each valid small RNA–mRNA target pair identified through the imported gene table. Included variables consist of small RNA class, normalized mean expression, log₂ fold change, and adjusted p-value for both the small RNA and corresponding mRNA target.

Only target pairs with valid differential expression statistics in both datasets are retained. Genes lacking calculable fold-change estimates or adjusted p-values are excluded from integrative analysis. Small RNA class assignments are obtained from the imported gene table, whereas normalized expression values and differential expression statistics are derived directly from the DESeq2 output.

`r paste(knitr::knit_child(text = integrative_results_tables_out, quiet = TRUE), collapse = '\n')`

\newpage

## Cosmic Plots {.tabset}

Cosmic plots are interactive scatter plots that visualize differential expression relationships between small RNAs and their corresponding mRNA targets across shared experimental contrasts. For each target pair, the small RNA log₂ fold change is displayed on the x-axis and the corresponding mRNA log₂ fold change is displayed on the y-axis.

Target pairs are categorized into four significance groups according to adjusted p-value and fold-change thresholds applied independently to both small RNA and mRNA datasets: (1) both significant, (2) significant small RNA only, (3) significant mRNA only, or (4) neither significant. Statistical significance is defined as an adjusted p-value below the selected threshold together with an absolute log₂ fold change exceeding the selected fold-change cutoff.

Point color reflects log₂-transformed mean small RNA abundance, while point size reflects mRNA log₂ mean expression for target pairs with statistically significant mRNA differential expression. Quadrant annotations summarize the number of target pairs within each significance category, enabling rapid assessment of directional expression relationships across the dataset.

Because many small RNAs are associated with transcript destabilization or translational repression, inverse-direction patterns (small RNA upregulated with mRNA downregulated, or vice versa) may be consistent with regulatory relationships. However, these visualizations are intended for exploratory interpretation and do not independently establish causality.

Plots are generated for experimental contrasts shared between both datasets and specified through the associated YAML parameter file.

`r paste(knitr::knit_child(text = cosmic_plots_out, quiet = TRUE), collapse = '\n')`

\newpage

## Slope Plots {.tabset}

Slope plots provide an alternative visualization of fold-change relationships between small RNAs and their corresponding mRNA targets. For each target pair, a line connects the small RNA log₂ fold change on the left side of the plot to the associated mRNA log₂ fold change on the right side.

Plots are separated by small RNA class, as specified through the associated YAML parameter file. Within each class, lines are colored by significance group: both small RNA and mRNA significant, significant small RNA only, significant mRNA only, or neither significant. For slope plots, significance is determined using adjusted p-value thresholds only.

Line opacity is scaled inversely with the number of target pairs within each class, so classes containing more target pairs appear more transparent. Slope plots are useful for assessing whether target pairs within selected small RNA classes tend to show coordinated or opposing fold-change directions.

`r paste(knitr::knit_child(text = slope_plots_out, quiet = TRUE), collapse = '\n')`

\newpage

## Statistical Analysis {.tabset}

Statistical Analysis provides a quantitative summary of global small RNA–mRNA relationships across each comparison. These summaries allow users to assess whether the data exhibit patterns consistent with inverse regulatory relationships between small RNAs and their mRNA targets.

`r paste(knitr::knit_child(text = statistical_analysis_out, quiet = TRUE), collapse = '\n')`

\newpage

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {

  var DIM_OPACITY  = 0.04;
  var TRACE_COLORS = ['#E65396', '#2171B5', '#E69F00', '#808080'];

  // Store original state per figure on first encounter
  var origOpacity = new WeakMap();
  var origLine    = new WeakMap();
  var origY       = new WeakMap();

  function saveOriginals(div) {
    if (!origOpacity.has(div)) {
      origOpacity.set(div, div.data.map(function (t) {
        return (t.marker && t.marker.opacity !== undefined) ? t.marker.opacity : 1;
      }));
    }
    if (!origLine.has(div)) {
      origLine.set(div, div.data.map(function (t) {
        // marker.line is for scatter markers; line is for slope plot lines
        var ml = t.marker && t.marker.line;
        var tl = t.line;
        return {
          color: (tl && tl.color) || (ml && ml.color) || 'rgba(0,0,0,0)',
          width: (ml && ml.width) || 0
        };
      }));
    }
    if (!origY.has(div)) {
      origY.set(div, div.data.map(function (t) {
        return t.y ? t.y.slice() : null;
      }));
    }
  }

  // ---- Scatter plot update ----
  function updateScatter(div, regex) {
    saveOriginals(div);
    var ops     = origOpacity.get(div);
    var lines   = origLine.get(div);

    // quadrant counts per significance group
    var qcounts   = TRACE_COLORS.map(function () { return [0, 0, 0, 0]; });
    var cdTraceIdx = 0;

    div.data.forEach(function (trace, ti) {
      if (!trace.customdata || !trace.customdata.length) return;

      var colorIdx = cdTraceIdx++;

      if (!regex) {
        // Restore original state — no outline, original opacity
        Plotly.restyle(div, {
          'marker.opacity':    ops[ti],
          'marker.line.color': lines[ti].color,
          'marker.line.width': lines[ti].width
        }, [ti]);
        // Count all points for quadrant display
        trace.customdata.forEach(function (cd, pi) {
          if (colorIdx < qcounts.length) {
            var x = trace.x[pi], y = trace.y[pi];
            var qi  = (x > 0 ? 0 : 1) + (y > 0 ? 0 : 2);
            qcounts[colorIdx][qi]++;
          }
        });
        return;
      }

      // Build per-point arrays
      var opArr  = [], lcArr = [], lwArr = [];
      trace.customdata.forEach(function (cd, pi) {
        var match = regex.test(String(cd));
        if (match && colorIdx < qcounts.length) {
          var x = trace.x[pi], y = trace.y[pi];
          var qi  = (x > 0 ? 0 : 1) + (y > 0 ? 0 : 2);
          qcounts[colorIdx][qi]++;
        }
        opArr.push(match ? 1.0 : DIM_OPACITY);
        lcArr.push(match ? 'black' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
        lwArr.push(match ? 1.5    : 0);
      });

      Plotly.restyle(div, {
        'marker.opacity':    [opArr],
        'marker.line.color': [lcArr],
        'marker.line.width': [lwArr]
      }, [ti]);
    });

    // Update quadrant annotation texts
    var anns = div.layout.annotations;
    if (!anns) return;
    var newAnns = anns.map(function (ann) { return Object.assign({}, ann); });
    newAnns.forEach(function (ann) {
      var x = ann.x, y = ann.y;
      var isCorner = (
        (Math.abs(x - 0.98) < 0.01 || Math.abs(x - 0.02) < 0.01) &&
        (Math.abs(y - 0.98) < 0.01 || Math.abs(y - 0.02) < 0.01)
      );
      if (!isCorner) return;
      var qi = (x > 0.5 ? 0 : 1) + (y > 0.5 ? 0 : 2);
      ann.text = TRACE_COLORS.map(function (color, ci) {
        return "<span style='color:" + color + "'>&#9679;</span> " +
          (qcounts[ci] ? qcounts[ci][qi] : 0);
      }).join('<br>');
    });
    Plotly.relayout(div, { annotations: newAnns });
  }

  // ---- Slope plot update ----
  function toFullOpacity(rgbaStr) {
    // "rgba(r,g,b,a)" → "rgba(r,g,b,1)"
    if (typeof rgbaStr !== 'string') return rgbaStr;
    return rgbaStr.replace(/rgba\(([^,]+),([^,]+),([^,]+),[^)]+\)/, 'rgba($1,$2,$3,1)');
  }

  function updateSlope(div, regex) {
    saveOriginals(div);
    var origYArr   = origY.get(div);
    var origLineArr = origLine.get(div);

    div.data.forEach(function (trace, ti) {
      if (!trace.customdata || !trace.customdata.length) return;
      var baseY = origYArr[ti];
      if (!baseY) return;

      if (!regex) {
        // Restore original y and original line color
        Plotly.restyle(div, {
          y:            [baseY.slice()],
          'line.color': origLineArr[ti].color
        }, [ti]);
        return;
      }

      // Hide non-matching segments; show matching at full opacity
      var hasMatch = false;
      var newY = baseY.map(function (yval, pi) {
        var cd = String(trace.customdata[pi] || '');
        if (cd === '') return null;
        var match = regex.test(cd);
        if (match) hasMatch = true;
        return match ? yval : null;
      });

      Plotly.restyle(div, {
        y:            [newY],
        'line.color': hasMatch ? toFullOpacity(origLineArr[ti].color) : origLineArr[ti].color
      }, [ti]);
    });
  }

  // ---- Identify and update all plots ----
  function applySearch(searchTerm) {
    var regex = null;
    if (searchTerm && searchTerm.trim()) {
      try { regex = new RegExp(searchTerm, 'i'); } catch (e) {}
    }

    document.querySelectorAll('.js-plotly-plot').forEach(function (div) {
      if (!div.data || !div.data.length) return;
      var t0 = div.data[0];
      if (!t0.customdata) return;

      // Distinguish by x-axis type: scatter=numeric, slope=categorical ("sRNA"/"mRNA")
      var firstX = t0.x && t0.x.length ? t0.x.find(function(v){ return v !== null && v !== undefined; }) : null;
      if (firstX === null || firstX === undefined) return;

      if (typeof firstX === 'number') {
        updateScatter(div, regex);
      } else if (firstX === 'sRNA' || firstX === 'mRNA') {
        updateSlope(div, regex);
      }
    });
  }

  // ---- Hook into DT search box ----
  function attachSearch() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.dataTables_filter input[type=search]').forEach(function (input) {

      // Keyup: only update the table (fast), not the plots
      input.removeEventListener('keyup', input._searchHandler);
      input._searchHandler = function () {
        var api = $(input).closest('.dataTables_wrapper').find('table').DataTable();
        api.search(this.value, true, false).draw();
      };
      input.addEventListener('keyup', input._searchHandler);

      // Inject "Plot" button next to the search box (once only)
      if (!input._plotBtnAdded) {
        var btn = document.createElement('button');
        btn.textContent = 'Plot';
        btn.title = 'Update scatter and slope plots based on current search';
        btn.style.cssText = [
          'margin-left:8px',
          'padding:3px 14px',
          'font-size:13px',
          'cursor:pointer',
          'border:1px solid #aaa',
          'border-radius:3px',
          'background:#f8f8f8'
        ].join(';');
        btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
          applySearch(input.value);
        });
        input.parentNode.insertBefore(btn, input.nextSibling);
        input._plotBtnAdded = true;
      }
    });
  }

  // DT may not be ready at DOMContentLoaded — poll briefly
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    var attempts = 0;
    var timer = setInterval(function () {
      if (document.querySelectorAll('.dataTables_filter input').length > 0 || attempts > 20) {
        clearInterval(timer);
        attachSearch();
      }
      attempts++;
    }, 300);
  });

})();
</script>
```
